title: Fantastic house.  Gaudi's original project just as special as his others.  This is a Must-Do experience.
text: The Old Lady would not miss the tour of Casa Vicens.  Seeing Gaudi's original project was going to be a highlight of this trip to Barcelona.  It did not disappoint.  The house is absolutely a Do-Not-Miss for any Gaudi fan.  Everything about this house delighted her.  She says it is sad homes are not designed like this one.  The gelato at the end was a welcome treat on such a hot day.  This is a wonderful tour and we would highly recommend it.  The Old Lady would absolutely do it again.
author: GrumpyandtheOldLady

title: Superb.
text:
A superb visit, very interesting and enriching regarding the history and work of Gaudí. Every architectural detail is a pleasure for the eyes. 
The exterior is also magnificent. The ice cream offered with the Sweet Gaudí entrance allows you to end the visit on a delicious sweet note.
author: Getaway25826906039

title: Worthwhile visit!
text: Beautiful house! The colours are amazing and it’s a must see. The extra sweet treat with the ticket was nice to sit in the cafe and appreciate the architecture. Added bonus was it wasn’t as busy as some of the other houses so was able to see more!
author: rebeccabQ3494OB

title: Amazing
text: Friendly photografer, good price for the pictures. I really like the pictures, thank you for the nice pictures. We love it.
author: Discover21751003796

title: Casa Vincens during the Christmass holidays
text: Great place to go, welcoming place also for kids. Very welcoming staff who helped us more than they had to - they helped us to solve an issue with late arrival (due to plane delay). Hot chocolate with churros was nice last dot behind our visit.
author: 585helenal

title: Cinnamon Roll
text: The blue tones are a reminiscents of the Bleu Majorelle in Marrakech, but as a correction there is no yoghurt cake in the winter session, instead you get a cinnamon roll, which is absolutely first class.

title: Highly recommended!
text: An incredibly beautiful building, you should definitely take a guided tour or use an audio guide. The route around the house is very conveniently and clearly organized. It is better to buy tickets in advance.
